text: From 15 Oct to 21 Oct 2026, satellite passes recorded 48 sites that qualified as persistent gas flares, each seen on at least three of the seven nights. The flares were concentrated in Rivers (20 sites), Delta (13 sites) and Bayelsa (6 sites). The two hottest persistent flares were Eastern Obolo in Akwa Ibom with an average FRP of 5.42 MW (seen on 4 nights) and Warri South‑West in Delta with an average FRP of 4.67 MW (seen on 5 nights). On the latest night (21 Oct) no detections were recorded, but clouds can hide flares, so the count does not prove they have stopped.
